Ellen (CSM): Quick sync: Meridian dedicated pool onboarding this week. Need final quota matrix, autoscale policy, scheduled loadtests, and a short renewal note. Renewal owner wants initial health checks T+72h.
Mateo (Solutions Eng): OK. What steady/burst targets?
Priya (SRE): Suggested baseline 120 qps, steady 260 qps, bursts 600 qps for 3-5m. Test plan: smoke 5m, ramp 20m, soak 40m.
Mateo (Solutions Eng): I'll do KV warmup T-24h and run three passes. Will share scripts.
Jo (Support): I'll be on-call during tests. Share alert thresholds and playbook please.
Priya (SRE): Alerts: error_rate > 1% for 60s -> warn; p95 > 650ms for 2m -> scale; p99 > 1100ms -> page. Fallback: route to quantized-small model if p95 > 800ms for 60s.
Ellen (CSM): Also capture a 1-question feedback card in enablement email and schedule a 15m post-soak sync with customer's eng lead.
Mateo (Solutions Eng): Load command I'll run:

```
./hammer --target https://staging.api.redwood/meridian --rps 260 --duration 40m --pattern ramp --header "x-account:meridian"
```

Mateo (Solutions Eng): KV prime:

```
python tools/prime_kv.py --account meridian --file meridian_prompts.json --concurrency 6
```

Priya (SRE): Autoscale snippet (draft):

```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 12
  metric: p95_latency_ms
  target: 430
  eval_window_sec: 60
  cooldown_sec: 90
```

Jo (Support): I'll publish a short playbook (logs to check, how to flip fallback, who to page) and attach CSAT link.
rex-bot: deployment scheduled 2024-10-11T03:00Z for meridian/onboard - ticket CS-9021 :white_check_mark:
Ellen (CSM): Action items: 1) Priya: commit autoscale policy + add runbook link. 2) Mateo: upload load scripts + raw metrics. 3) Jo: publish support playbook + CSAT. 4) Ellen: send renewal note + enablement + feedback card. Please ping when done. :thumbsup:
